summary: This note is the source code of the ROS C++ file dwa_planner_ros.cpp, the ROS wrapper for the Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) local planner, licensed under the BSD license and copyright Willow Garage, Inc. It is authored by Eitan Marder-Eppstein. The file registers DWAPlannerROS as a nav_core::BaseLocalPlanner plugin, handles dynamic reconfigure and parameter setup, and implements plan setting, goal checking, local/global plan publishing, and velocity command computation, including switching to a stop-and-rotate controller when the robot is near the goal position.
one_line: ROS C++ source for the DWA local planner plugin wrapper (DWAPlannerROS) that computes velocity commands and publishes plans.
key_facts: The file is licensed under the BSD License and its copyright is held by Willow Garage, Inc. in 2009.
The author listed in the file header is Eitan Marder-Eppstein.
DWAPlannerROS is registered as a nav_core::BaseLocalPlanner plugin using PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS.
The reconfigureCB function copies dynamic reconfigure values into a base_local_planner::LocalPlannerLimits struct and passes them to planner_util_ and dp_.
In initialize(), the planner advertises the topics global_plan and local_plan as nav_msgs::Path publishers in the private namespace.
The initialize() function reads an optional parameter named odom_topic and sets it on odom_helper_ via setOdomTopic.
initialize() warns about renamed parameters, including max_vel_trans to max_trans_vel and theta_stopped_vel to rot_stopped_vel.
setPlan() resets latching on latchedStopRotateController_ before calling dp_->setPlan, logging 'Got new plan'.
dwaComputeVelocityCommands() calls dp_->findBestPath and sets cmd_vel.linear.x, linear.y and angular.z from the drive commands.
If the best path cost is below zero, dwaComputeVelocityCommands publishes an empty local plan and returns false, logging that cost functions discarded all candidates.
computeVelocityCommands() returns false with the error 'Could not get local plan' if planner_util_.getLocalPlan fails.
When latchedStopRotateController_.isPositionReached is true, computeVelocityCommands publishes an empty plan and calls computeVelocityCommandsStopRotate.
The destructor of DWAPlannerROS deletes the dynamic reconfigure server dsrv_.
The local plan is built by converting each path point to a PoseStamped with z set to 0.0 and orientation from setRPY(0, 0, p_th).
